# Intake question list

<!-- Generated by tools/build_lite.py from the full skill. Edit the source in skills/enterprise-experts/, then rebuild. -->

Record each answer in `intake.json` under `answers`, with the key shown. "I don't know" is recorded as `"unknown"`. Never fill in an answer by guessing.

## Always ask

| Key | Question | Answers | Why it is asked |
|---|---|---|---|
| `purpose` | In one or two sentences: what does this project do, and for whom? | free text | Every expert calibrates severity to what the system is for. |
| `stage` | What stage is the project at? | `prototype`, `pre_launch`, `production` | A prototype and a live system need different bars. |
| `exposure` | Who can reach it? | `internal`, `partners`, `public` | Public exposure raises the security and reliability bar. |
| `industry` | Which industry or domain is it in? | `healthcare`, `finance`, `government`, `education`, `ecommerce`, `logistics`, `internal_tool`, `other` | Decides which regulations may apply. |
| `data_types` | Which kinds of data does it store or process? (choose all that apply) | `none`, `personal`, `credentials`, `payment_card`, `financial_records`, `health`, `government_id`, `children`, `business_confidential` (several allowed) | Drives the risk profile and the release gates. |
| `handles_money` | Does it move or charge money (payments, payouts, wallets, invoices)? | `yes`, `no` | Money flows need tests, idempotency and audit trails. |
| `review_mode` | Which review do you want? | `full`, `quick`, `focused` | Full = all 23 experts, quick = 8 core areas, focused = the areas you name. |
| `change_permission` | May I change code, or assess only? | `assess_only`, `fix_on_branch_after_approval` | Assessment is read-only by default; fixes need your approval of a plan first. |
| `environments_allowed` | Which environments may I run things against? (choose all that apply) | `none_read_code_only`, `local`, `staging` (several allowed) | Load, resilience and E2E tests only run where you allow. Production is never a test target. |

## Ask when you cannot establish the answer from the project

| Key | Question | Answers | Why it is asked |
|---|---|---|---|
| `execution_allowed` | Besides reading the code, may I: run the project's own tests and build, install its dependencies, use Docker, run tools that contact the network (for example a dependency audit)? Or only tools that read the files without running the project's code? (choose all that apply) | `run_project_tests`, `install_dependencies`, `use_docker`, `network_tools`, `read_only_tools_only`, `none` (several allowed) | Each one changes something or sends something out; without your yes those checks are recorded as not assessed. |
| `critical_journeys` | What are the 3-5 things that must never break (e.g. login, checkout, report export)? | free text | Tests, SLOs and UX review focus on these. |
| `users_scale` | Roughly how many users/requests now, and what do you expect in 12 months? | free text | Capacity and cost plans need a target. |
| `users_regions` | Which countries are your users and your company in? | free text | Determines which privacy laws to check (e.g. GDPR, Lebanon Law 81/2018). |
| `deadline` | Is there a launch date or deadline this review should serve? | free text |  |
| `known_problems` | Any known problems or worries you want checked first? | free text |  |
| `team` | Who maintains this (team size, roles)? Who should own fixes? | free text |  |
| `out_of_scope` | Anything I must not touch or look at? | free text | Respected by every expert. |
| `report_language` | Which language for reports? | `english`, `arabic`, `both` |  |
| `hosting` | Where is it hosted (provider, plan), and can I get read-only access to that configuration? | free text |  |
| `deploy_process` | How is it deployed today, and how do you roll back? | free text |  |
| `monitoring_tools` | Which monitoring/error tracking tools exist, and can I get read access? | free text |  |
| `alert_recipient` | When it breaks at 3 a.m., who gets notified and how? | free text |  |
| `latency_targets` | Any speed targets (e.g. page loads under 2.5 s, API under 300 ms)? | free text |  |
| `innovation_scan` | Besides reviewing what exists, should the team also look for newer technologies, AI models and integrations (such as MCP servers) that would help this project, and propose them with sources? And may anything about the project be included in web searches? | `no`, `yes_generic_searches_only`, `yes_project_details_allowed`, `unknown` | Looking things up is optional and costs time; nothing is adopted without your approval, and search terms reveal what you are building unless they are kept generic. |
| `compliance_targets` | Any standards or certifications you must meet (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS...)? | free text |  |
| `data_owner` | Who owns customer data decisions (retention, deletion requests)? | free text |  |
| `kpis` | Which numbers tell you the product is succeeding? | free text |  |
| `issue_tracker` | Do you want findings created as tickets (Jira/GitHub/Linear)? Which project? | free text |  |
| `budget_limits` | Any limit on time or AI usage for this review? | free text | Lets the orchestrator choose depth and parallelism. |

## Ask only when the project has the thing in brackets

| Key | Question | Answers | Why it is asked |
|---|---|---|---|
| `focus_areas` [mode focused] | For a focused review: which areas (numbers 1-23 or names)? | free text | Sets the required scope for the scorecard. |
| `db_environment` [has database] | Which database is used in production, and is there a local/staging copy I can use? | free text |  |
| `backups` [has database] | Are backups configured? How often, where are they stored, and who can delete them? | free text |  |
| `restore_tested` [has database] | Has a restore from backup ever been tested? When? | `yes`, `no`, `unknown` | An untested backup counts as unknown, not as protection. |
| `rto_rpo` [has database] | How long can the system be down, and how much data could you afford to lose (RTO/RPO)? | free text |  |
| `ci_access` [has ci] | Can I see CI run history (e.g. GitHub Actions)? | `yes`, `no` |  |
| `billing_access` [has paid services] | Can you share current monthly costs or invoices (hosting, APIs, SaaS)? | free text | Without billing data the cost analysis is an estimate and is labelled as one. |
| `spend_caps` [has paid services] | Are spending limits or budget alerts set on the paid services? | `yes`, `no`, `unknown` |  |
| `ai_usage` [has ai] | What does the AI/LLM do here, can users influence the prompt, and what tools/data can it reach? | free text | Needed to assess prompt injection, data leakage and inference cost. |
| `external_ai_allowed` [has ai] | May project code or data be sent to third-party AI providers during this review or by the product itself? If yes, which providers and which data? | free text | Nothing is sent to an outside provider without your say; free or cheap models are not assumed safe for private data. |
| `ai_quality_bar` [has ai] | How do you judge the AI feature today (test questions, an evaluation set, user feedback)? | free text | Model or prompt changes need something to be measured against. |
| `deployment_goals` [deployable] | For hosting: what matters most (lowest cost, least maintenance, full control), what is the monthly budget, and who will operate it? | free text | The deployment recommendation is the simplest option that meets these, not the most powerful. |
| `ui_run` [has ui] | How do I run the interface locally (command, URL, a test account without real data) so I can capture real screenshots? | free text | Screenshots are taken from the running app, never mocked. |
| `ui_audience` [has ui] | Who uses the interface (devices, languages, RTL/Arabic, accessibility needs)? | free text |  |
| `mobile_release` [has mobile] | Which app stores/platforms do you ship to, and how are builds signed and released? | free text |  |
| `api_consumers` [has api] | Who consumes the API (your own apps, partners, public)? Any versioning promises? | free text |  |
| `monorepo_scope` [is monorepo] | This is a monorepo. Which apps/packages are in scope? | free text |  |
